questions.text: Decode the T9 mobile keypad cipher [ 7777 - 33 - 777 - 888 - 33 - 777 ]. What is the decoded keyword?
Using the Infrastructure Node Directory, look up the decoded keyword under Cluster Alias. What is its Physical Deployment Zone?

hints.text: Look at the numbers as old mobile keypad (T9) taps, where pressing the key multiple times picks the position of the letter.
The sequence spells out an IT infrastructure term found in the Cluster Alias column of Document B.
The decoded word is SERVER. Check the table for SERVER and write down its Physical Deployment Zone.
